posts.text: Great job Jake, smashing your swim time 👏👏

Our June Bike Night just hooked another gear! ⚙️

Make sure you join us on Thursday, June 25th, from 6 PM – 9 PM for our second Bike Night of the year with special guest Harrison Dessoy of PHR Performance Racing.

Meet and Greet the World Sportbike racer, fresh off his podium at Aragon,
With his PHR Performance Triumph Daytona 660 🏍️

As well as all the excitement outside, you can explore the newest bikes from all our franchises, fresh arrivals in our clothing & accessories department, refresh your look with our in-house barbers, grab a bite of the fresh menu at Café53, and connect with fellow riders for a fantastic evening to mark the opening of the riding season!

RSVP to let us know you're coming and share your evening with us here 👉https://fb.me/e/6RiMf3Qos

Entry: £2 on gate – CARD & CASH payments received gratefully by Devon Air Ambulance 🚁

#BridgeBikeNight #JuneEvents #Exeter #BridgeMotorcycles #HD55

Misano ✅
-
Race 1: P21
Race 2: P16 
-
On the back foot this weekend, but not through a lack of trying. Misano was a new circuit for me and proved to be super technical, and i found it super tricky to find some good pace and click with the track. 
-
In race 2, I had the best feeling with the bike, made improvements alone, understood the circuit better and taken the positives into the next round.
-
A big break now, but training hard and will be better prepared for Magnycours.
-
A big thank you to my family, team and sponsors for the vital support during a tough weekend. We’ll bounce back in France 😋.
